The 4-step blurred-noise hypothesis (the only structural alternative that could explain a deterministic plateau) is rejected in signal mode (WEAK, variance_ratio 238%, structured residual FWHM 24px). The remaining 8.4-level residual concentrates in block_boundary (33%) and global variance_ratio (25%), but every discrete change that reduces it (stronger JPEG, stronger blur, contrast weaken) lowers full-pipeline PSNR. With k=1 only pair0 is available, so stochastic blur alternatives (motion random angle, glass random shuffle) cannot be arbitrated by a single-pair PSNR. Evidence insufficient to change; R0 pipeline retained for R1 training and training-PSNR arbitration.
